Question Choices: A clock currently reads 10:00. What time will it show in 57 hours? Give your answer in 12-hour format.
Hints: The 12-hour clock repeats every 12 hours — reduce 57 using mod 12;Add the reduced value to 10:00 and simplify mod 12 if needed
Solution: 57 = 4 x 12 + 9, so 57 hours is the same as 9 hours on a 12-hour clock. 10:00 + 9 hours = 19:00, and 19 - 12 = 7, so the clock shows 7:00.

Question Choices: Runner A laps a track in 15 minutes and Runner B in 20 minutes. If they start at the same time, how many minutes until they next meet at the starting line?
Hints: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 15 and 20;Prime factorize each number and take the highest power of each prime factor that appears
Solution: They meet at the start line after LCM(15, 20) minutes. 15 = 3 x 5 and 20 = 2^2 x 5, so LCM = 2^2 x 3 x 5 = 60 minutes.
